description: VN 'gọi/nhắn cho' transfer: learners calque 'cho'=to onto the transitive verbs phone/text ('phone to me', 'text to him'). Rule en-vietlish-phone-text-to drops 'to' ONLY when the VERB phone/text is immediately followed by 'to' + a person pronoun. 'call' is EXCLUDED (held). A negative lookbehind blocks the NOUN 'text' ('send/read a text to me'); the pronoun-object requirement blocks the infinitive ('phone to confirm').
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. 'to' is correct after the NOUN 'text' (send/read a text to me) and in purpose infinitives ('phone to confirm'). V1 fires only on the VERB phone/text + 'to' + person pronoun. Negatives: the noun 'text' with a determiner, an infinitive 'to confirm', the EXCLUDED verb 'call', and an already-correct no-'to' sentence.

positive.input: I will text to them later.
positive.notes: Modal + base verb 'text' + 'to them' -> drop to.

positive.input: She phones to us every morning.

negative.input: Please send a text to me.
negative.expectedCorrection: Please send a text to me.
negative.notes: Noun 'text' (lookbehind 'a') -> 'to' is correct, must abstain. (Precision lock.)

negative.input: She read the text to him.
negative.expectedCorrection: She read the text to him.

negative.input: I phoned to confirm the time.
negative.expectedCorrection: I phoned to confirm the time.
negative.notes: 'to confirm' is a purpose infinitive, not a person pronoun -> must not fire.
'call' is EXCLUDED from this rule (held: 'call to me') -> must abstain. (Hold-compliance lock.)
